regions.today: Cloud increasing with rain moving in from the west this evening. Southwest winds will be moderate to fresh.
regions.tonight: Outbreaks of rain and drizzle at first tonight, turning heavy at times. The rain will clear eastwards overnight with clear spells and scattered showers following. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a bright, fresh day with sunny spells and scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
